sections._why: the hook: thunder and storm air only
nine at night, the plane slides into the cloud, Gus asleep; stops for the bang
bang, the white flash (downbeat), the scream, the hands, the bolt against the fuse
'But wait': dead stop with the record_stop; cabin hum underneath
the explanation: lazy electricity, the skin, nose to tail
a few volts, less than a wall socket
no accident: once a year, the plane sets it off
he shuffles to the bathroom, the charge builds
zap, three thousand volts, the doorknob did; button after the last word
